verdict.rationale: Check is an embedded payroll API, so PTO policies with accruals and approvals that flow into payroll are a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers time off, PTO policies, accrual rules or time-off approvals. The only approval documented is payroll approval (check-docs-3), and the feature list (check-docs-35) covers benefits, deductions and garnishments but not PTO, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define PTO policies with accruals and approvals that apply automatically to payroll
